scope: Ten newv2 SmartSoft machines; released MultiHot40 and existing four completed machines are excluded.
important: Raw archived tables stay unchanged. Live help confirmed normalized scatter ratios for all three Burning Ice titles and a SuperWild payout divisor of10 despite five fixed lines. All ten fixed native distributions have exact rational RTP below100%, with no supported prize clipped or scaled. These are independent native laws, not provider-private RNG.

exactNativeReturn.method: Exact enumeration of the 8^5 symbol sequences on each public line, linearity over the 100 fixed paths, and independent wheel mean 15/4.

results.proof: Complete8^5 marginal enumeration and weighted wheel, asserted by test/smartsoft-slot-rounds.test.mjs.

remaining: The exact native probability law is independently specified. The provider-private probability law is not claimed.
